If it would be helpful in your language, you could use an equivalent expression or state the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [and the messages from Yahweh that you speak]
If your language does not use an abstract noun for the idea of **truth**, you could express the same idea in another way. Alternate translation: [is true]
